name: Grafana
setup:
Signs Home Assistant users in to Grafana: admins become Grafana admins, everyone else viewer. Add to `grafana.ini` (or the matching `GF_…` environment variables) and restart Grafana:

```ini
[server]
root_url = %(protocol)s://%(domain)s{base}/
serve_from_sub_path = false

[auth.proxy]
enabled = true
header_name = Remote-User
header_property = username
auto_sign_up = true
headers = Role:Remote-Role
whitelist = <IP of Home Assistant>

[live]
allowed_origins = https://<your Home Assistant address>
```

- `whitelist`: only Home Assistant may send the login headers.
- `serve_from_sub_path` stays `false`: the proxy strips the path, Grafana builds its links from `root_url`. Grafana then works only through Home Assistant, not when opened directly.
- `allowed_origins`: every address you open Home Assistant with (local, Nabu Casa, …), otherwise live updates fail.
